cohort: 102 pregnant individuals who experienced preterm labor in 2020 at a tertiary care hospital in Mangalore, India.
finding: A high proportion of individuals experiencing preterm labor had genitourinary tract infections, with E. coli and Candida being the most common organisms found in urine and high vaginal swabs, respectively.
mod_finding: 59% of the preterm newborns were delivered vaginally.
birth_weight: recorded but specific values not reported
